import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.itertools import zip_matched
from pocket_coffea.processors.base import BaseProcessor
from pocket_coffea.utils.logging import get_logger

log = get_logger()


class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""

    def object_preselection(self, variation):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4."""
        muons = self.events.Muon

        muon_good = muons[
            (muons.pt > 15)
            & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        ]

        self.events["MuonGood"] = muon_good

    def object_counting(self, variation):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event."""
        self.events["n_muons"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)
